gtpc.server.address.description: Local IP for S11 (GTP-C) interface to SGW-C.

hss.server.address.description: IP address of the HSS (Diameter peer for S6a).

hss.server.hostname.description: Diameter Hostname of the HSS (must match certificate CN/ SAN).

hss.server.realm.description: Diameter Realm of the HSS (typically same as MME realm).

hss.tls.ca.description: Path to CA certificate for HSS TLS verification.

hss.tls.cert.description: Path to MME client certificate for mutual TLS.

hss.tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS for secure S6a connection to HSS.

hss.tls.key.description: Path to MME client private key for mutual TLS.

mme.mme_code.description: MME Code: 8-bit identifier (0–255) unique within tracking area. Combined with MME GID to form MME-GUI.

mme.mme_gid.description: MME Group ID: 16-bit identifier (0–65535) identifying the MME group. Part of MME-GUI for eNodeB addressing.

mme.name.description: MME instance name (FQDN), used for identification in logs and interfaces.

mme.realm.description: Diameter realm for MME, typically matching the domain in subscriber HSS.

pgwc.server.address.description: IP address of the PGW-C (S5/S8 control plane).

s1ap.peers.description: List of eNodeB peers (cells) connecting to this MME. Each defines a peer identity and IP.

address.description: IP address of the eNodeB for S1-MME connection.

mme_gui.description: Optional MME-GUI override for this peer (default: computed from mme.mme_gid/mme_code).

name.description: Friendly name for the eNodeB peer.

s1ap.server.address.description: Local IP address of the MME for S1-MME (control plane) interface to eNodeB.

sgwc.server.address.description: SGW-C IP address (S11 peer) — only required if separate from local gtpc.server.

sgws.description: List of S-GW instances (for load balancing/fallback) for S1-U/S11 (if separate from default SGW).

spgws.description: List of SPGW-C/S-GW instances for S5/S8 (e.g., in non-3GPP offload or split PGW scenarios).

subscribers.description: Static subscriber list (for lab/demo). For production, use Diameter/HSS. Each entry contains IMSI, MSISDN, and APNs.

apns.description: List of APNs provisioned for this subscriber.

qci.description: QCI (QoS Class Identifier) — e.g., 9 for default bearer, 1 for voice.

pgw_address.description: Static PGW IP address (for fixed PGW assignment).

pool.description: Name of the IP pool to allocate subscriber address from.
